'''2020 World Championship''' was the Players Committee World Championship on GEMP (Day 1 5–6 December, Day 2 12 December, Day 3 13 December 2020). [[Joe Olson]] defeated [[Quirin Fürgut]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-world-championships/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' 5–6 and 12–13 December 2020
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/joe-olson-wins-the-25th-star-wars-ccg-world-championship/ forum]
